correctness.rationale: The subgroup lattices reduce to an explicit balanced double star. Aut(C_{p^2}×C_p) is parametrized by e↦ae+bf and f↦pce+df, while the modular-group relation forces a↦a^i b^j and b↦a^{pk}b. The induced leaf maps are coupled affine permutations with reciprocal slopes. Parameter counts give the stated images and kernels, and direct finite enumeration at p=3,5 plus action checks at p=3,5,7 corroborate every formula.

value.rationale: The two nonisomorphic groups are a natural test case because prior work already shows their inclusion graphs coincide. Computing the natural lifting map isolates exactly how subgroup-containment symmetries differ from genuine group symmetries: the same affine permutation image is obtained in both cases, but the invisible automorphism kernels have orders p(p−1) and p. This is a structural loss-of-information statement rather than a routine graph invariant.
